
== Mutations ==

[[File:MutationForge.png.png|thumb|The '''Mutation Forge''' at [[Frozen Peak]]]]
'''Equipment Mutations''' enhance [[Equipment|equipment]] by altering their appearance and providing a universal stat multiplier. Every piece of equipment can receive '''one''' mutation.

A piece of [[Equipment|equipment]] has a small chance to acquire a '''mutation''' when crafted. Certain [[Events]] may change the odds for obtaining a certain mutation.

The player can also reroll a '''mutation''' by utilizing the '''Mutation Forge''' located at [[Frozen Peak]], which requires a specific [[Minerals|catalyst]] to use. The catalyst needed depends on the equipment. When a mutation is rolled, the player can choose to keep the existing mutation or apply the new mutation. 
* The player can also use a [[Relics|Festive Catalyst]] to apply {{Enchant|Festive}} to a piece of equipment.
* The player can also use a [[Relics|Prismatic Catalyst]] to apply {{Enchant|Prismatic}} to a piece of equipment.

Adding more of the appropriate catalyst increases the appearance chance of better mutations.

== Effects ==
Each mutation provides a universal stat multiplier, with some giving additional additive bonuses:
* {{Enchant|Silver}}: 1.1×
* {{Enchant|Gold}}: 1.2× 
* {{Enchant|Diamond}}: 1.35× 
* {{Enchant|Granite}}: 1.36×, +24 {{Stat|Dig Strength}}, +6 {{Stat|Shake Strength}}
* {{Enchant|Overclocked}}: 1.36×, +10% {{Stat|Dig Speed}}, +10% {{Stat|Shake Speed}}
* {{Enchant|Festive}}: 1.4×, +50 {{Stat|Luck}}, +10% {{Stat|Size Boost}}
* {{Enchant|Prismatic}}: 1.6×
